svg.title: ThingsBoard 3.6 Actor runtime: startup, mailbox routing and partition change

g.text: ThingsBoard 3.6 Actor runtime: startup, mailbox routing and partition change
If ready is still false, the message remains queued.
tell returns without waiting for Actor processing.
load tenant / initialize owned rule chains
Queue message through four mailbox turns
validate state and select first/continuation node
The polled message is not automatically requeued.
Callback completion depends on business code.
High priority does not interrupt an executing message.
Continuous high traffic may starve normal traffic.
filter Device children no longer owned
Actor state and pending mailbox messages are local only.
The new owner rebuilds state; no actor migration occurs.
Global stop does not iterate every Actor and call destroy().
